archetypes.name: test-observation-surface
archetypes.rationale: Test case 5 proposes verifying dedup by grepping the claude stub's argv for --context-files, but launch-claude-subprocess.sh inlines context files into a rendered prompt passed to claude via stdin — claude's $@ is only --model and --print; --context-files never appears there.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check every proposed test assertion against what is actually observable at the point being asserted. For test case 5 (dedup), trace the execution path: launch-claude-review.sh → launch-claude-subprocess.sh renders context files into a $PROMPT_RENDERED file and passes it to claude via stdin (not as argv tokens). The claude stub's $@ will contain only --model and --print, so grepping it for --context-files will always return zero matches regardless of whether dedup works. Identify the earliest point in the call chain where dedup can actually be observed (either capturing launch-claude-subprocess.sh's own argv before it renders the prompt, or inspecting the rendered prompt for duplicate context_file_N sections) and flag the discrepancy. Also check test case 3's described invocation: ${2:?msg} triggers on empty/unset, not on a value that looks like a flag — verify the described invocation produces the asserted exit code and stderr message, not a different failure mode. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-resolution-gap
archetypes.rationale: The issue's R4/FINDING_1 identifies that Voter 1 callers use --context-files on launch-claude-review.sh which didn't exist; the plan adds the flag but states 'No new callers added' without documenting which of the three resolution options is adopted for the ballot-context problem.
archetypes.prompt_body: The issue context lists three R4/FINDING_1 resolution options for the Voter 1 ballot-context problem: (a) extend the launcher with --context-files, (b) reuse --scope-files, (c) compose ballot inline into the prompt file. This plan implements option (a) but explicitly states 'No new callers added.' Check whether the plan documents which resolution path is being taken and whether dispatch-plan-voters.sh and dispatch-code-voters.sh will be updated in a later piece or are intentionally left as-is. Read dispatch-plan-voters.sh (lines 71-78) and dispatch-code-voters.sh (lines 103-110) to confirm the current caller state, then flag any gap between what the issue's R4/FINDING_1 resolution requires and what this plan actually delivers or explicitly defers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sibling-doc-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds 6 test cases to test-launch-claude-review.sh but does not mention updating its sibling test-launch-claude-review.md, which lists harness coverage and must be updated in the same PR per .claude/rules/script-md-siblings.md.
archetypes.prompt_body: For every .sh file the plan modifies, verify that the plan also lists the corresponding sibling .md update. Read scripts/test-launch-claude-review.md and scripts/launch-claude-review.md and check whether the plan's listed file modifications include all required sibling updates. The .claude/rules/script-md-siblings.md rule requires sibling .md files to be updated in the same PR as behavior changes; test-launch-claude-review.md line 5 lists the current coverage set and must be extended when new test cases are added. Also verify that the plan's launch-claude-review.md additions correctly describe the --allow-root derivation behavior: --allow-root forwarding for explicit context-file paths already exists in the current code (the new work extends it to explicit paths), so the documentation addition should not describe this as a new capability. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
